referenceDelivery: Unmodified archived Horizons output retrieved from the Astronomy Engine validation repository, not new direct NASA API responses.
definition: Solar-center topocentric altitude > 0 degrees; WGS84 observer at elevation zero. No atmosphere, terrain, limb correction or twilight. Integrate within the 24-hour local mean solar date (UTC midnight minus longitude/15 hours).
runtime: Pinned coefficients bundled locally; location-specific yearly results computed and cached locally.
accuracy: Numerical model, not exact measurements. Astronomy Engine targets positions within 1 arcminute. Grazing polar crossings are especially sensitive to angular error.
